en.h1: Film look on iPhone: tone, grain and skin are three separate jobs
en.lead: Most film filters feel vintage for a second, and then you notice the face has gone green. The filter is rarely the problem; tone, grain and skin got bundled into one slider.
en.answer: A convincing analog look is a colour tone (the mood), grain and light leaks (the texture), and skin that still reads as skin (the limit). Set the tone first, add texture second, then check the face on its own. Done in that order, it does not need a subscription.
paras: Real film has a handful of separable traits: highlights that lean warm or green, shadows with a touch of blue, grain of a certain size, darkened corners and the occasional light leak. One-tap retro presets push all of them at once, which is why the whole frame, face included, drifts yellow or green and people start looking unwell.

The steadier approach is to pick a base tone, then decide on grain and light leaks separately. For portraits keep the grain, it stops skin looking like plastic, but keep leaks in corners away from the face. PhotoCream Pro: Film Filters gives you 100+ hand-tuned looks with grain, halation, light leaks and vignette as separate controls, full curves, HSL and split toning, and a live preview so you see the exact look before you shoot. It is free to download with a single one-time unlock, no subscription, no ads, and everything is processed on the device.

The last step is always zooming into the face. A film look can shift the whole image, but the whites of the eyes should not go green and lips should not go grey. If skin needs smoothing, use a frequency-separation method that treats texture and colour separately; it keeps the film grain where flattening the whole frame would erase it.

loc.answer: 褐噪音把能量集中在低頻，聽起來像遠方的瀑布或飛機艙內的轟鳴，比白噪音沙沙的高頻柔和得多，蓋人聲和腳步聲也更自然。要整晚播放，重點是聲音不會循環、能離線、有淡出的睡眠計時器，以及鎖屏後不會停。

en.title: Does brown noise help you sleep, and how to play it offline all night | Sereno: Sleep Sounds
en.meta: Brown noise is low-frequency and softer than white noise. For all-night play: no loops, offline, fade-out timer. Sereno: Sleep Sounds, one-time purchase.
en.h1: Brown noise: why it is easier on the ears and how to run it all night
en.lead: A roommate gaming at 2 a.m., renovation next door, a room facing the road. Plenty of people try white noise, find it harsh and give up. Switching to brown noise changes the experience.
en.answer: Brown noise concentrates its energy in the low end, like a distant waterfall or an aircraft cabin, far gentler than the hiss of white noise and more natural at masking voices and footsteps. For a full night the priorities are sound that never loops, playback that works offline, a timer that fades out, and no interruption when the screen locks.
paras: White, pink and brown noise differ in how energy is spread across frequencies: white is equal everywhere and sounds sharp; pink trims the highs; brown trims them most, leaving a low rumble. Voices and keyboard clicks sit in the mid range, and a bed of low-frequency brown noise pushes them into the distance. It does not remove the noise; it stops sudden sounds from grabbing your attention.

Two things ruin an all-night session: loop seams and a dropped connection. A looping audio file has a seam every few minutes that eventually wakes you, and a streamed sound stops the moment the dorm Wi-Fi drops. Sereno: Sleep Sounds generates its sounds live on the device, so nothing repeats and it works fully offline; you can layer brown noise under a fan or rain and set the volume and EQ of each track, the sleep timer fades out softly instead of cutting off, and it supports background playback with lock-screen controls. It is a one-time purchase with no subscription and no ads.

Set the volume to just cover the loudest sound in the room, not louder. For focus during the day go a notch quieter than for sleep; too loud is tiring. If you play through a Bluetooth speaker or earbuds all night, check the battery will last first.

Most people find brown noise gentler because it has little high-frequency content and sounds like a distant rumble; white noise is sharper and can wear on you. Try each for one night.

en.h1: Voice to text notes: how a recording becomes text you can find later
en.lead: The problem with recordings is never capturing them. It is that nobody listens again. The note only starts once the voice has become text.

Third, make the text findable. Export the note as text or Markdown and put it where you already search, whether that is Notes or the company drive, so next week a keyword brings back the deadline someone mentioned. The free tier gives 3 notes a day at up to 3 minutes each, enough to test how well your speaking style transcribes; longer recordings and PDF export come with Pro, a one-time purchase with no subscription.

loc.answer: 把每天的量壓到五個字、固定綁在一個已經存在的時段（例如上班那段捷運），而且不需要網路和事前準備，連續天數才守得住。Wordmate Lite 每天五個單字 就是照這個做法設計的：打開就練五個字，離線可用，不用註冊。
paras: 停在第三天的原因很少是懶，多半是量訂錯了。第一天興致高，做了三十個字；第二天趕時間只做十個，覺得自己輸了；第三天乾脆不開。把每日目標降到五個字，連最糟的那天都做得完，連續天數就不會斷——守住連續天數，比某一天多背二十個字重要得多。
第二個關鍵是把練習綁在一個不用做決定的時段。捷運進站到出站之間、超商排隊結帳、等公車，這些一分鐘的空檔本來就存在，不需要另外「找時間」。Wordmate Lite 每天五個單字 就是為這種空檔設計的：畫面上是一條小石子鋪成的路，踩過五顆就結束，結束時把今天的五個字完整列出來給你看；整套內容可離線使用，捷運隧道裡收訊斷掉也不會中斷，不需要帳號、不蒐集個人資料。

第三是不要自己做單字卡。重新開始的人最常卡在「先把牌組整理好」這一步，然後就再也沒開始。挑一個真的會用到的主題——要出差就選商務、下個月去東京就選旅遊——從入門難度開始，看到想留下來的字按一下存起來，系統會依主題和難度分好組。免費版可以選定一種語言、一條生活主題，練入門難度的前 10 個字並收藏最多 3 個字，先用這個額度把習慣養起來；覺得順手再一次購買解鎖 44 種語言、14 個主題與全部難度，沒有訂閱制。

en.title: Learn five words a day on the commute and keep the streak, with Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary
en.meta: Daily vocabulary dies on day three because the dose is wrong. Five words, one subway stop, no decks. Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary works offline, no account.
en.h1: Daily vocabulary: why it stops on day three, and the five-word fix
en.lead: Adults restarting English, Japanese or Korean rarely lack material. What they lack is a daily action too small to skip.
en.answer: Cut the daily dose to five words, attach it to a slot that already exists (the subway ride to work), and make sure it needs no internet and no preparation; that is how a streak survives. Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary is built around exactly that: open it, walk five words, done, offline, no account.
paras: Stopping on day three is rarely laziness; it is usually the wrong dose. Day one is enthusiastic and you do thirty words. Day two you are rushed, manage ten, and feel you have lost. Day three you do not open the app. Drop the daily goal to five words so that even the worst day is finishable, and the streak stays alive, which matters far more than one heroic day of twenty.

The second key is tying practice to a moment that needs no decision. Between tapping in and tapping out on the subway, queueing at the convenience store, waiting for the bus: these one-minute gaps already exist, so you never have to find time. Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary is designed for those gaps. The screen is a trail of pebbles; step over five and the day is done, with the closing screen listing exactly the five words you just learned. Everything runs offline, so a tunnel with no signal changes nothing, and there is no account and no personal data collected.

Third, do not build your own flashcards. People restarting a language most often stall at sorting out a deck first, and never start. Pick a path you will actually use, business for a trip for work, travel for next month in Tokyo, begin at beginner level, and save any word worth keeping with a tap; saved words are grouped by topic and level. The free tier keeps one language and one path open at beginner level, enough to build the habit; when it sticks, a single one-time purchase unlocks all 44 languages, 14 paths and every level, with no subscription.

faq: Are five words a day really enough?
Enough is whatever you can sustain. Five words for thirty days is 150 words, far more than thirty on day one and then nothing. Once it feels easy, the daily goal can go to 10, 15 or 20.
Can I learn Japanese and Korean in Wordmate Lite: Vocabulary?
Yes, there are 44 learning languages. The free tier keeps one language and one path open at beginner level; the rest stay visible so you can see what is there, and one purchase unlocks all of them.
Does it freeze when the subway has no signal?
No. All content works offline, and pronunciation uses the device's own text-to-speech voice, so words are still read aloud without a connection.

en.title: How to open a password-protected ZIP, RAR or 7z on iPhone with Zipbox: Unzip RAR, ZIP & 7z
en.meta: Files only opens plain ZIPs; a password-protected ZIP, RAR or 7z needs another app. Save it, enter the password, take one file. Zipbox works on device, no ads.
en.h1: How to open a password-protected ZIP, RAR or 7z on iPhone, step by step
en.lead: Files shows the archive, but tapping it does nothing, or only offers to share it. This page starts from the moment the file arrives and ends with the one item you needed.
en.answer: The built-in Files app only extracts plain ZIPs; a password-protected ZIP, and any RAR or 7z, will not open. You do not need an upload-and-extract website: install an extractor that works on the device, open the archive from Files or the share sheet, enter the password, look inside and pull out only what you need. Zipbox: Unzip RAR, ZIP & 7z is that kind of app, with no network, no ads and one purchase for every feature.
paras: First make sure the file is actually on the phone. An archive received in a chat app has to be opened in the conversation and saved with Save to Files; a Gmail attachment is long-pressed and saved the same way; a Safari download lands in the Downloads folder of Files. The most common dead end is a file that was never downloaded at all, just an icon in a chat window.

Then look at the extension. A .zip with no password opens with a tap in Files; a password-protected .zip, .rar or .7z needs another app. Two things matter when choosing one: explicit support for password-protected and multi-part archives, and processing that stays on the device. Zipbox: Unzip RAR, ZIP & 7z handles password-protected and multi-part ZIP, RAR and 7z, lets you browse the file list without extracting, preview photos, PDFs and text, and pull out only the item you want; it makes no network requests, has no account and no ads, and is a paid App Store download where one purchase includes every feature.

Finally, safety. A school or employer sends a password-protected archive precisely because it holds personal data or grades, and dropping it into an online extractor hands over both the password and the contents. Extracting on the phone keeps the file and the password on the device; when you need to share the result, send it back through the same mail or chat it came from.

steps: Save the archive to Files: open it in the chat and choose Save to Files, long-press a Gmail attachment for the same option, or find a Safari download in Downloads.
In Files, long-press the archive, choose Share and pick Zipbox; or open Zipbox and browse to that folder.
Enter the password you were given. For multi-part archives, check first that every .part file is in the same folder.
Browse the list and preview photos or PDFs, then tick only the files you actually need instead of extracting everything.
Export the extracted files to Files or iCloud Drive, then send them back through the same chat or email.

en.h1: One-page summary: getting tonight's 16:9 slide out of a thirty-page report
en.lead: The review is tomorrow morning, you have a thirty-page report and an hour of meeting notes, and your manager wants one page. The problem is not layout; it is deciding what survives.
en.answer: Start with a single conclusion sentence, pick at most three numbers or points that support it, then let the visual follow the data: numbers become a column or line chart, steps a process flow, dates a timeline. OnePage PPT: AI Slide Maker distils pasted text, screenshots or a PDF into one 16:9 slide and exports an editable .pptx, all on the device.
paras: Write the conclusion first. Flip to the end of the report and answer the question so what in one sentence, such as Q3 renewals recovered, driven by enterprise accounts. That sentence is the slide title and everything else serves it. If you cannot write it, you have not understood the material yet, and no template will fix that.

Then choose the supports. Three at most: one set of numbers, one comparison, one timeline. Feed the matching paragraphs, table screenshots or PDF pages straight into OnePage PPT: AI Slide Maker, which pulls out the key points and picks the right visual: numbers become column or line charts, steps become a process flow, two options become a comparison, and it only draws a chart the data can honestly support, never inventing figures. Once the first draft is up, try the one-tap redesigns such as Cleaner or More Professional to see a few directions, lock the elements you like and rebuild around them.

Last, the delivery format. If someone else has to keep editing, export an editable .pptx with live text boxes and charts that open in PowerPoint, Keynote or Google Slides; if it is going into a group chat to be read, a PDF or high-resolution PNG is safer because nobody needs office software installed. Everything is processed on the device, so the report and screenshots are never uploaded, there is no account and no queue. You can try it free, and Lifetime Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription.

One conclusion plus at most three supports. Past three, split into a second page or go back and narrow the conclusion.
Can the pptx from OnePage PPT: AI Slide Maker be edited on a computer?
Yes. The exported .pptx keeps editable text boxes and charts rather than a flat image, and opens for further editing in PowerPoint, Keynote or Google Slides.
My report is confidential; is it safe to use?
Nothing is uploaded. All processing runs on your iPhone or iPad, projects and images stay on the device, and exported files only leave it when you share them yourself.

en.title: Save links from WeChat, Xiaohongshu and the browser with SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks, no account
en.meta: Links vanish because they sit in each app's favourites with no tags. One place, tags on save, a few read daily. SaveTag saves from the share sheet, no account.
en.h1: Saving links you can actually find again: WeChat, Xiaohongshu and the browser in one place
en.lead: Saved in WeChat, favourited in Xiaohongshu, bookmarked in Safari: three piles in three apps, and when you need one, none of them turns up.
en.answer: Links disappear because they are scattered across each app's own favourites and were saved without tags. The fix is one collection that needs no account, tags written automatically on save, and a read-later rhythm that clears a few items a day. SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks works exactly that way: one tap from the share sheet or clipboard, tags written on the device, no sign-up.
paras: First, drop the habit of saving wherever you happen to be reading. WeChat articles, Xiaohongshu notes and browser pages each have their own favourites, and three months later you cannot remember which app holds that recipe. Change the rule: anything worth keeping, from any app, goes to the same place. In a WeChat article use the top-right menu and Copy Link, in a Xiaohongshu note use Copy Link from its share options, and in the browser use the share sheet directly.

Second, let the tags write themselves. Manual filing never survives a week, so choose a tool that files each save the moment it lands. SaveTag: AI Social Bookmarks takes a share from any app with a share sheet and also quick-saves straight from the clipboard after you copy a URL; title, source site and preview come in automatically, and each save is sorted on the device into precise topics such as shopping, recipes, travel, parenting and finance, which you can correct or extend with custom tags. When you look for something later, search runs across titles, notes, tags and sources, so a vague memory is enough.

Third, actually come back. A read-later pile turns into a black hole when the list has no exit. SaveTag's Rediscover surfaces a small handful of unread saves each day, with a goal ring and a streak, and you tick each one off as you read it, so the list shrinks instead of growing. Everything stays on the iPhone: no account, no cloud, no ads. The free tier has every feature and keeps your latest 5 saves; SaveTag Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited saves, custom tags and Markdown export, with no subscription.

en.title: Fix a blurry photo of a child on iPhone without uploading it, with Unblurry Pro: Unblur & HD
en.meta: Each blur needs its own fix: Sharpen for shake, Low Light for dark rooms, Document for notes. Unblurry Pro: Unblur & HD runs on the iPhone, no subscription.
en.h1: Fixing a blurry photo: rescuing a shaky shot of your child right on the iPhone
en.lead: A child who moved, a dog mid-jump, a school notice photographed in a hurry: too blurry to use, too precious to delete. Which mode you reach for depends on what kind of blur it is.
en.answer: Different blur needs different treatment. Shake and soft focus want Sharpen, dark indoor shots want Low Light, notices and receipts want Document, and a photo that arrived tiny wants Upscale. Unblurry Pro: Unblur & HD runs all of these on the iPhone itself, so the photo never leaves the phone.
paras: Start by zooming in to see what kind of blur you have. If the outline of a face is dragged in one direction, that is hand shake or movement; if the whole frame is evenly soft, that is focus; if it is dark and grainy, that is low-light noise. A photo that came through a chat app looking small and mushy is not blurred at all, it lost resolution in transit, so an upscaling mode is the right tool.

Once you know the type, pick the mode. Unblurry Pro: Unblur & HD has eight: Auto Clear, Sharpen, Denoise, Low Light, Document, AI Super Resolution, 4x Upscale and Portrait & Restore. A running child or dog wants Sharpen, a dinner shot in a dim restaurant wants Low Light, a school notice or contract wants Document to crisp up the text, and an old family photo wants Portrait & Restore. Everything is processed on the iPhone, so a photo of your child is never sent to a server, and you can press the before/after slider to peek at the original at any point.

The last question is how you save. You can enhance and save for free every day; to export without a watermark and at the full original resolution, you unlock Unblurry Pro once. It is a single purchase rather than a subscription, with no ads and no tracking. If a result looks over-sharp, running Auto Clear instead usually gives a more natural look.

steps: Child or pet photos: use Sharpen to take out the shake, and add Portrait & Restore if the face is small.
Dark indoor photos: brighten with Low Light, then clean up any remaining grain with Denoise.
School notices and receipts: use Document to crisp the text, then zoom to 100% to check the numbers.
Photos that arrived small through a chat app: enlarge with 4x Upscale or AI Super Resolution first, then sharpen.
Before saving, press the before/after slider to compare with the original, and rerun with Auto Clear if it looks overdone.

loc.meta: 温泉や京都、沖縄など2〜3日の旅は、日ごとのタイムラインに時間・場所・メモを並べるだけで迷いが減ります。TripBee Lite：旅程プランはアカウント不要・広告なしで、無料版は旅を1件保存できます。
loc.h1: 2泊3日の旅程表：時間・場所・メモを1本のタイムラインに
loc.lead: 友人や家族との国内旅行は、予定が多すぎても少なすぎても疲れます。必要なのは、電車の中でさっと見返せる1本の時間軸です。
loc.answer: 日ごとに「出発時刻・移動・滞在先」を一列に並べ、各予定に住所と予約番号をメモとして添えるのが基本形です。1日に回る場所は3〜4か所までに絞ると、温泉でも京都でも無理なく動けます。
paras: まず骨組みは移動から作ります。新幹線や飛行機の時刻、ホテルのチェックイン時間を先に置き、その間に観光や食事を差し込むと、移動時間を見落とさずにすみます。沖縄ならレンタカーの返却時刻、京都なら拝観の受付終了時刻が、その日の長さを決める基準になります。

次に、各予定へ「現地で必要な情報」だけを添えます。予約番号、集合場所の目印、温泉旅館の夕食時間など、当日に探し回りたくないものです。TripBee Lite：旅程プランは、日ごとのタイムラインにフライト・宿泊・予定を並べ、メモやリマインダー、チケット情報を必要な場所にまとめられる旅行プランナーで、アカウント登録は不要、広告や解析、トラッキングもありません。無料版は一度に1件の旅を保存でき、予定の変更はいつでもできます。
最後に、同行者と見る前提で書きます。「10:00 清水寺」より「9:40 京都駅バス乗り場D1集合 → 10:15 清水寺」のほうが、当日の問い合わせが減ります。旅程は出発の前日に一度通しで読み、移動の間隔が20分を切る箇所があれば予定を1つ減らしてください。

en.title: How to plan a two-night trip itinerary in Japan with TripBee Lite: Trip Planner
en.meta: A 2–3 day trip to an onsen or Kyoto needs one day-by-day timeline with times, places and notes. TripBee Lite: Trip Planner, no account, no ads.
en.h1: A two-night itinerary: times, places and notes on one timeline
en.lead: A short trip with friends or family goes wrong when there is too much or too little in the plan. What you need is a single time axis you can glance at on the train.
en.answer: Line up departure time, transport and where you are staying for each day, attach the address and booking reference to every entry as a note, and cap each day at three or four places so an onsen town or Kyoto stays relaxed.
paras: Build the skeleton from transport first. Put shinkansen or flight times and the hotel check-in on the timeline before anything else, then slot sightseeing and meals into the gaps so travel time is never forgotten. In Okinawa the rental-car return time sets the length of the day; in Kyoto it is the last admission time at the temples.

Next, attach only what you will need on the spot: booking numbers, a landmark for the meeting point, the dinner time at the ryokan. TripBee Lite: Trip Planner lays flights, hotels and plans on a day-by-day timeline and keeps notes, reminders and ticket references where they belong. No account is required, and there are no ads, analytics or tracking. The free app saves one journey at a time, and you can edit or replace it whenever plans change.

Finally, write it as if a companion will read it. '09:40 meet at Kyoto Station bus stop D1 → 10:15 Kiyomizu-dera' causes fewer questions on the day than '10:00 Kiyomizu-dera'. Read the whole plan once the evening before you leave; wherever two entries are less than 20 minutes apart, drop one.

Whether opening the plan requires an account or a login

Slot sightseeing and meals into the gaps, three or four places per day.

Read the plan end to end the night before and remove anything less than 20 minutes from its neighbour.
On the day, read top to bottom in time order and do not reshuffle on the spot.

en.fits: TripBee Lite: Trip Planner suits someone who wants to give one upcoming 2–3 day trip their full attention: a day-by-day timeline with notes and ticket references, no account, no ads or analytics. The free app saves one journey, and the single non-consumable Premium purchase is not a subscription.
faq: How far ahead should I start the itinerary?
Right after the hotel and transport are booked. Fill in the fixed times first and settle the sightseeing a week before departure so changes stay easy.
How do I keep the group on the same plan?
Put the meeting time and place in the entry title and have everyone read the same plan rather than relaying it verbally. A change should mean editing one line.
Is the free version of TripBee Lite: Trip Planner enough for a two-night trip?
The free app saves one journey at a time with a day-by-day timeline, notes, reminders and ticket references. Replace it with the next trip when you are done.

loc.title: 子どもと飛行機・新幹線、旅行ゲームは何を用意する？Trip Planet 子ども旅行ゲームで静かに遊ぶ
loc.meta: 4〜8歳と飛行機や新幹線に乗るなら、音を出さず短時間で区切れる遊びと、旅そのものを課題にするミッション型が相性抜群です。Trip Planet 子ども旅行ゲームは広告なし、買い切りです。
loc.h1: 子連れの飛行機・新幹線：旅行ゲームは「静か・短い・旅と結びつく」で選ぶ
loc.lead: 機内や車内で困るのは、ゲームの音と「まだ着かないの？」の繰り返しです。遊びが旅の中身とつながっていると、退屈が冒険に変わります。
loc.answer: 音なしで遊べて、5〜10分で一区切りつき、しかも「空港でチケットを見せる」「窓から3つの色を探す」のように旅そのものを課題にするゲームが、4〜8歳の移動時間にいちばん向いています。
paras: 準備の軸は3つです。ひとつ目は音。機内でも新幹線でも、効果音が鳴る遊びはイヤホンが外れた瞬間に周囲の目が集まります。ふたつ目は区切りの短さ。着陸前や乗り換えで途中終了しても泣かずに済むよう、1回が数分で終わるものを選びます。みっつ目は、画面の中だけで完結しないことです。

その3つ目を満たすのがミッション型の遊びです。Trip Planet 子ども旅行ゲームは、3〜10歳の子ども向けに、長いフライトや車移動、ホテルでの時間をミッションに変える旅行ミッションアプリです。旅行を作ってMission Packsを選ぶと、星座マップに「新しい食べ物に挑戦」「空港で勇気を出す」「美術館で3つの色を探す」といった小さな課題が並び、達成するとごほうびとパスポートのスタンプが集まります。広告なし、第三者トラッキングなし、外部サーバーもなく、買い切りでサブスクリプションではありません。
当日の運用は、乗る前に「今日のミッションは3つ」と決めて見せることです。離陸や発車の直後に1つ、落ち着いた頃に1つ、降りる前に1つ。親が端末を持つ場面でも、ふたりの保護者がそれぞれの端末で同じ旅を共有できる仕組みなら、交代しても進み具合がずれません。

faq: 搭乗前に準備しておくことはありますか？
旅行の作成とMission Packsの選択を出発前に済ませておくと、乗ってからすぐ始められます。Trip Planet 子ども旅行ゲームは外部サーバーを使わず、家族の共有はiCloudで同期します。

「ありがとうを言う」「3つの色を探す」のように一言で伝えられる課題なら理解できます。読めない子には親が読み上げて、達成を一緒に確認します。
Trip Planet 子ども旅行ゲームに広告や課金の誘導はありますか？
広告はなく、第三者トラッキングもありません。購入と共有は保護者ゲートで守られ、買い切りでサブスクリプションではありません。

en.title: Kids travel games for a flight or shinkansen ride with Trip Planet: Kids Quest
en.meta: Flying or on the bullet train with a 4–8 year old? Pick play that is silent, short and makes the journey the game. Trip Planet: Kids Quest, no ads.
en.h1: Travel games for kids on a plane or train: silent, short, tied to the trip
en.lead: What goes wrong in a cabin is noise and the endless 'are we there yet'. When the play is about the trip itself, boredom turns into an adventure.
en.answer: The best games for a 4–8 year old in transit make no sound, finish in five to ten minutes and use the journey as the challenge: show the ticket at the gate, find three colours out of the window, try a new food.
paras: Plan around three things. First, sound: on a plane or a train, any game with sound effects draws stares the moment an earbud falls out. Second, short rounds: something that ends in a few minutes can be stopped for landing or a transfer without tears. Third, play that does not live entirely inside the screen.

Mission-style play covers that third point. Trip Planet: Kids Quest is a travel-missions app for children aged 3–10 that turns long flights, car rides and hotel stays into missions. Create a trip, choose Mission Packs, and small real-world quests appear on a constellation map: try a new food, be brave at the airport, spot three colours at a museum. Completed missions unlock rewards and a passport stamp for every finished trip. There are no ads, no third-party tracking and no external servers, and it is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

On the day, announce 'three missions today' before boarding. One right after take-off or departure, one once things settle, one before you get off. If both parents take turns holding the phone, a trip that two parents share from their own devices keeps the progress in sync.

Hand out the first one in the restless minutes right after departure or take-off.
Put a challenge that only works on the move, such as the window view or the in-flight meal, in the middle.
Give the last mission 30 minutes before arrival and check the reward together once you are off.
At the end of the trip, look back at the passport stamps together and talk about the next journey.

en.fits: Trip Planet: Kids Quest suits parents travelling by plane or bullet train with a 4–8 year old: Mission Packs for flight days, hotels, food and museums turn small actions into an adventure with rewards and passport stamps. No ads, no third-party tracking, one-time purchase, no subscription.
faq: Is there anything to set up before boarding?

Create the trip and pick the Mission Packs before you leave so the game can start as soon as you sit down. Trip Planet: Kids Quest uses no external servers and shares the trip between parents through iCloud.
Can a four-year-old understand the missions?
Yes, when a task fits in one sentence, such as 'say thank you' or 'find three colours'. For a child who cannot read yet, read it aloud and confirm the result together.
Does Trip Planet: Kids Quest show ads or push purchases?
There are no ads and no third-party tracking. Purchases and sharing sit behind a parent gate, and it is a one-time purchase rather than a subscription.

loc.title: Wi-Fiにつながっているのにネットが使えない：WiFi Aid Lite で1分でルーター・DNS・プロバイダを切り分ける
loc.meta: 自宅・ホテル・カフェで「接続済みなのに開かない」とき、再起動の前に確認する順番があります。WiFi Aid Lite はDNS・TCP・TLSを同時にチェックし、最も可能性の高い原因を数秒で提示します。1回は無料です。
loc.h1: Wi-Fiはつながっているのにネットが使えない：原因は3つのどれか
loc.lead: 扇マークは出ているのにページが開かない。原因はルーター、DNS、プロバイダのどれかで、順番に見れば1分で見当がつきます。
loc.answer: まず別のサイトとIPアドレス直打ちで開くか試し、次にスマホのモバイル回線で同じサイトを開きます。名前解決だけ失敗すればDNS、IPでも開かなければルーターか回線、モバイルでも開かなければサイト側の問題です。
paras: 自宅では、ルーターが「つながっている」と言っているだけで、その先のプロバイダ側が落ちていることがよくあります。ホテルやカフェでは、ログイン画面（キャプティブポータル）が出ずに止まっているケースが大半です。まずブラウザで普段使わないサイトを開き、ログイン画面が出るかどうかを確かめてください。

次の段階は証拠集めです。名前解決（DNS）、接続（TCP）、暗号化（TLS）のどこで止まっているかがわかれば、再起動すべきなのがルーターなのか、変えるべきなのがDNS設定なのか、待つしかないプロバイダ障害なのかが決まります。WiFi Aid Lite は、ワンタップでWi-Fi・DNS・インターネット接続をまとめて診断し、DNS・TCP・TLS・応答時間を複数の独立した経路で同時にチェックして、最も可能性の高い原因を数秒で提示します。全ツール合わせて完全なチェックが1回無料で、気に入れば1回限りの買い切りで永久アンロック、サブスクリプションはありません。
「時々つながらない」タイプは一度の確認では見つかりません。遅延の揺らぎ（ジッター）を続けて観測し、過去の結果と比べる必要があります。履歴が端末内に残っていれば、プロバイダに問い合わせるときに「何時に、どの項目で失敗したか」を具体的に伝えられ、話が早く進みます。

en.title: Wi-Fi connected but no internet: router, DNS or provider? WiFi Aid Lite: Network Check
en.meta: 'Connected but nothing loads' has three usual causes: router, DNS or provider. Check in order before rebooting. WiFi Aid Lite: Network Check, one tap.
en.h1: Wi-Fi connected but no internet: which of the three is it
en.lead: The Wi-Fi icon is on and the page will not load. The cause is the router, DNS or the provider, and checking in order narrows it down in about a minute.
en.answer: Open a different site, then try an IP address directly, then open the same site on mobile data. If only the name lookup fails it is DNS; if the IP fails too it is the router or the line; if mobile data fails as well, the site itself is down.
paras: At home the router often reports 'connected' while the provider's side beyond it is down. In hotels and cafés the most common cause is a captive-portal login page that never appeared. Start by opening a site you do not normally visit in the browser and see whether a login page shows up.

The next stage is evidence. Knowing whether the name lookup (DNS), the connection (TCP) or the encryption (TLS) is the step that fails tells you whether to reboot the router, change the DNS setting or simply wait out a provider outage. WiFi Aid Lite: Network Check runs Wi-Fi, DNS and internet checks in one tap, gathers DNS, TCP, TLS and response-time evidence over several independent paths and points to the most likely cause within seconds. One complete check is free across all tools, and an optional one-time lifetime unlock gives unlimited use with no subscription.

loc.answer: Fotografieren Sie frontal vor einer hellen, einfarbigen Wand bei Tageslicht, schneiden Sie auf 35×45 mm zu, richten Sie Scheitel, Augenlinie und Kinn an Hilfslinien aus und legen Sie mehrere Kopien auf einen 10×15-Bogen für den Drogerie-Ausdruck. paras: Die meisten Ablehnungen kommen nicht vom Zuschnitt, sondern von der Aufnahme: Schatten hinter dem Kopf, ein geneigter Kopf, Haare vor den Augen oder ein Fenster, das eine Gesichtshälfte heller macht. Stellen Sie sich einen Meter vor eine helle, glatte Wand, lassen Sie das Tageslicht von vorn kommen und bitten Sie jemanden, aus Augenhöhe zu fotografieren. Neutraler Gesichtsausdruck, Mund geschlossen, Blick direkt in die Kamera.

Danach kommt der exakte Zuschnitt. Das Format 35×45 mm ist in Deutschland für Visumanträge, Führerschein, Bewerbungen und viele Ausweise verlangt, und die amtliche Fotomustertafel gibt vor, wie viel vom Bild das Gesicht einnehmen darf und wo die Augenlinie liegen soll. en.lead: A booth photo costs time, not skill. Daylight, a pale wall and an exact crop get you there at home, as long as you know which applications still accept a printed photo.
en.answer: Shoot straight on against a pale, plain wall in daylight, crop to 35×45 mm with the crown, eye line and chin on guides, and lay several copies on a 10×15 cm sheet for the drugstore printer. For a German passport or ID card, photos have had to be submitted digitally since May 2025, so a paper print will not help there.
paras: Most rejections come from the shot, not the crop: a shadow behind the head, a tilted face, hair over the eyes or a window lighting one side of the face. Stand a metre in front of a pale, smooth wall, let daylight fall from the front and have someone photograph you from eye level. Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes straight into the lens.

Then comes the exact crop. In Germany 35×45 mm is the format for visa applications, driving licences, job applications and many ID documents, and the official photo template sets how much of the frame the face may fill and where the eye line should sit. Snapport Lite crops your portrait to the chosen size right on the device: pick the 35×45 mm preset, line the face up with the head-top, eye-line and chin guides, switch the background to white or light grey if needed and refine the edges. Photos are never uploaded, the app works offline, every preset and tool is free to use, the first export is included, and a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited exports with no subscription and no ads.

For printing you need a 10×15 cm (4×6 in) sheet with several copies and cut guides. Save it as a JPEG to Photos, load it at the dm or Rossmann photo kiosk as an ordinary 10×15 print and cut along the marks at home. One important caveat: since 1 May 2025 German registration offices accept only digitally transmitted photos for passports and ID cards, from a certified photographer or the terminal at the office. An app only edits the picture; whether a photo is accepted is always decided by the office you submit it to.

Stay Clock: Flip Desk Clock turns your iPhone or iPad into an always-on clock: Keep Awake while charging with a battery floor or the system setting, a night schedule that switches to a dim red face on true black, and gentle pixel shifting to spare OLED screens. One complete face is included free, with no account, ads or tracking; an optional Lifetime purchase adds 100 more faces, with no subscription.

Finally, think about placement and sound. In landscape an iPad reads from across the bedroom; in portrait an iPhone fits a narrow shelf. The hourly chime can stay off at night, and a simple alarm saves opening another app in the morning. Wipe the screen before you set the device down: a fingerprint stands out on a black background.

loc.title: Облік часу навчання перед НМТ: години, серія днів і темп до іспиту зі Studydown: Облік часу
loc.meta: Готуєтеся до НМТ? Рахуйте реальні години, а не плани. Studydown: Облік часу рахує час, поки телефон лежить екраном донизу, і показує темп до іспиту.
loc.h1: Облік часу навчання перед іспитом: що рахувати і як не кидати
loc.lead: Розклад на папері каже, скільки Ви збиралися вчити. Облік часу каже, скільки Ви вчили насправді, і саме ця різниця вирішує результат НМТ.
loc.answer: Рахуйте лише час без телефона в руках, розбитий за предметами, і порівнюйте його з денним темпом, потрібним до дати іспиту. Серія днів поспіль важливіша за рекордні суботи: 40 хвилин щодня дають більше, ніж 6 годин раз на тиждень.
paras: Почніть із того, що саме Ви записуєте. Година з відкритим підручником і стрічкою новин у руці — не година навчання. Найчесніший спосіб обліку — запускати відлік лише тоді, коли телефон лежить екраном донизу, і зупиняти його, щойно Ви його піднімаєте. Так у підсумку дня залишається тільки час, за який Вам справді не соромно.

Далі потрібні три числа: сьогодні, цей тиждень і скільки ще лишилося до іспиту. Studydown: Облік часу записує час для кожного заняття, коли Ви кладете телефон екраном донизу на стіл, показує підсумки дня й тижня, кількість днів поспіль і розподіл між заняттями. Для кожного кінцевого терміну, наприклад дати НМТ, можна задати часову ціль і бачити записаний час та потрібний денний темп. Вимірювання працює на пристрої, без облікового запису й реклами; безкоштовно можна спробувати до 3 занять і загалом 5 хвилин запису, а одноразова купівля Pro відкриває необмежений запис, цілі, терміни й віджети — без підписки.

Нарешті, зробіть облік таким, щоб його хотілося продовжувати. Заведіть окремі заняття для української мови, математики та історії, задайте тижневу ціль, яку реально виконати в навчальний тиждень, і дивіться на серію днів, а не на суму. Якщо день пропущено, запишіть це чесно — нуль хвилин теж запис, і він підказує, де графік не витримує.

en.title: Track study hours and the exam deadline for NMT prep with Studydown: Face-Down Timer
en.meta: Preparing for the NMT or a certification? Count real hours, not plans. Studydown: Face-Down Timer logs face-down time and shows the pace to the exam.
en.h1: Tracking study time before an exam: what to count and how to keep going
en.lead: A paper schedule says how much you meant to study. A time log says how much you actually did, and that gap decides the exam result.
en.answer: Count only time with the phone out of your hands, split by subject, and compare it with the daily pace required before the exam date. A run of consecutive days beats record Saturdays: 40 minutes every day adds up to more than six hours once a week.
paras: Start with what you record. An hour with the textbook open and a news feed in your hand is not an hour of study. The most honest method is to start the count only when the phone lies face down and stop it the moment you pick it up, so the day's total contains only time you can stand behind.

Then you need three numbers: today, this week and how much is left before the exam. Studydown: Face-Down Timer records time for each activity when you place the phone face down on the desk, shows today and this week, consecutive days and a breakdown by activity. Each deadline, such as the NMT date, can carry an effort target so you see logged time and the daily pace still required. Timing works on the device with no account or ads; the free allowance covers up to 3 activities and 5 recorded minutes in total, and a single Pro purchase unlocks unlimited recording, goals, deadlines and widgets with no subscription.

Finally, make the log something you want to keep. Create separate activities for Ukrainian, maths and history, set a weekly goal you can actually meet in a school week, and watch the run of days rather than the grand total. If you skipped a day, record it honestly: zero minutes is also an entry, and it shows where the schedule breaks.

en.fits: Studydown: Face-Down Timer suits anyone preparing for the NMT, university exams or a certification who wants real hours instead of plans: the count runs while the phone lies face down, with daily and weekly totals, consecutive days, weekly goals and deadlines with the required daily pace. Everything works on the device with no account or ads, and the Pro purchase is one-time with no subscription.
faq: How many hours a day do I need for the NMT?
There is no universal figure. Divide the hours left before the exam date by the number of days and hold that pace; a regular 40–60 minutes per subject each day works better than rare marathons.
What if my run of days breaks?
Record the gap honestly and start a new run the next day. The point of the log is to see which weekday the schedule breaks on and remove the cause, not to punish yourself.
Does Studydown: Face-Down Timer need an account?

No. Timing and records work on the device with no account or ads. The free allowance is up to 3 activities and 5 recorded minutes in total; a one-time Pro purchase unlocks unlimited recording with no subscription.
